body_html:
1. Read
  2. Read the book again take notes or don't take notes..your call....I believe writing is easier with notes.
  3. Read
  4. Summarize the gist of the story. Include the title, author, illustrator and the main point/conflict in one or two sentences.
  5. Focus on stories place within the genre...Meaning if it is a mystery story talk about elements common to mystery,
  6. Say as little as possible about the story itself instead focus on some element such as:
    • Theme
    • Character Analysis
    • Word Choice
    • Illustration
    • Critical Analysis
  7. Avoid spoilers. They are mean if you must include disclaimer
  8. A recommendation
